title: Gus the Duck

scenes.summary: Gus runs and gets muddy while playing.

scenes.summary: Gus gets into the tub to clean himself.

scenes.image_prompt: cartoon duck sitting in bathtub full of bubbles, bright and cheerful illustration

scenes.summary: Gus rubs himself clean and plays in the tub.

scenes.summary: Gus happily hugs the bug at the end.
